test -d "$failed"
test -d "$operation"
for directory in "$failed" "$operation"; do

  rmdir "$directory"
done
rm -f "$root/incoming/install-0.1.0-SNAPSHOT-28da2413f1ceabc7.tar.gz" \
  "$root/incoming/install-0.1.0-SNAPSHOT-28da2413f1ceabc7.tar.gz.manifest"
printf '%s\n' STAGE6_FAILED_CANDIDATE_REMOVED
